text.en:
Municipality of Panabo, which shall comprise the western part
of the municipality of Tagum, bounded on the north, by the west
portion of the present boundary line between Tagum on one side
and the municipalities of Kapalong and Saug on the other; on
the west and south, by the present boundary line between the.
municipality of Tagum and the City of Davao; on the southeast,
by the limits of the municipal waters which this municipality
should have; and on the east by the Tagum River.
The municipality of Panabo contains the following barrios:
Panabo, where the seat of government shall be located; Ising,
which shall include the sitios of Mangalcal, Sibulano, and Southern
Davao; Maduao, which shall include the sitios of Upper Licanan,
Tagpuri, Tagurot, and Tagactac; Malatibas, which shall include
the sitios of Manay and Little Panay; Lasang, which shalll include
the sitio of small Panabo; Cagangohan, which shall include the sitio
of Pontakan; Anibungan, which shall include the sitios of San Mi-
guel and Kinamayan; and Bincungan, which shall include the sitios
of Lapaz and Tuganay.
The municipalities herein organized shall each begin
to exist upon the appointment and qualification of the
Mayor, Vice-Mayor, and a majority of the councilors
The municipality of Santa Cruz shall have its present
territory minus the portions thereof included in the munic-
ipalities of Digos and Padada.
The municipality of Tagum shall have its present ter-
ritory minus the portion thereof included in the munic-
ipality of Panabo.
Done in the City of Manila, this Ist day of July, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
•EXPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
